title: Venus' Atmosphere Isn’t Breathable

scenes.text: Many think Venus has a breathable atmosphere for humans.
scenes.label: Breathable Atmosphere Myth

scenes.text: Venus' air is thick CO₂, with trace nitrogen, and toxic sulfur dioxide, making it lethal to breathe.
scenes.label: CO₂ Toxic Fact

scenes.text: The planet’s sky is a toxic, crushing furnace.
scenes.label: Venus Furnace

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.
